acceptance_predicates.description: Setup and connectivity diagnostics remain usable when OPENROUTER_API_KEY or production authenticity material is absent, and report a warning.
An explicitly selected live run resolves OPENROUTER_API_KEY at run time, never persists or displays the secret, and returns a typed actionable failure when it is absent.
The development capability preserves the selected OpenRouter provider and supported model identity for the selected OpenCode/OpenDesk adapters.
The explicit local/mock route remains deterministic and a live run never silently falls back to mock or cassette execution.

definition_of_done: Exact merged ASB main contains the development credential bridge and focused live/provider tests.
Hosted PR checks pass with no secret-shaped output.
The evidence records the exact merged product head and preserves the separate production release boundary.

inputs.description: Persisted development provider/model selection and an environment-variable reference.
Optional OPENROUTER_API_KEY available only to the operator's explicit live run.

outputs.description: Short-lived development live-provider capability with redacted diagnostics and typed failures.

gates.description: No key value is persisted, printed, or included in evidence.
Only an explicit live selection may contact OpenRouter; setup warnings do not contact it.
